messages:
rachel: Hey team, noticed a sharp 5xx spike hitting hosted inference API around 09:12 UTC. Error rate jumped from ~0.3% to 5.8% across regions. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc/hosted-api?from=now-30m
support-bot: New customer ticket #C-78321 (Acme Corp) - "500 Gateway errors for text-generation, began ~09:10 UTC". Linked logs attached.
mike: I started the canary rollout for the new routing-weight optimizer at 09:05 UTC — feature flag dynamic-route-weighting=true for 10% traffic.
alice: Repro: I hit the /v1/generate endpoint and got repeated 502s. curl snippet:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream_gateway: connection reset"}
```
carlos: Checking proxy logs — seeing a lot of upstream connection resets to model-backend-gpu-pool-3. 503s correlate with routes pinned to that backend.
jen: Is the canary routing selector scoped to seed slices only? I see the flag set at org-level in the config service.
mike: Uh — I thought we applied it to slice=canary-2026-03-17 but looks like the selector was missing `scope:seed` and defaulted to `global`. deploying now.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline #deploy-4487 triggered: apply-config dynamic-route-weighting -> v2 (author: mike)
alice: That's the issue — global weight change amplified traffic to the new kernel selection path. New path has a concurrency bug causing connection churn under burst.
rachel: Customer impact: multiple high-priority accounts seeing timeouts and billing anomalies due to retries. CC @sales-ops for outreach.
mike: Initiating rollback to v1 config: `configctl rollback dynamic-route-weighting --to=stable-20260316 --reason=global-misapply`
carlos: SRE, can you temp-shed traffic off model-backend-gpu-pool-3? `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deployment/backend-pool-3 -n prod` will help stop errors while rollback completes.
sre-lead: Doing it now. Also enabling shedder: `redwood-shedder enable --tag=overflow-protect --max-inflight=10`
jen: Noted. Running smoke tests against /v1/health and /v1/generate for a few tenants.
sre-lead: scale done at 09:22 UTC. Error rate dropping — Grafana shows 5xx down to 0.9%.
mike: Rollback applied at 09:24 UTC, configctl returned success. Verifying config propagation across regions.
alice: Patch queued to fix kernel path concurrency; small hotfix will go to canary with explicit scope and tighter max connections.
rachel: Support update drafted and sent to affected customers. Sales notified.
support-bot: Ticket #C-78321 updated: "We rolled back the routing change. Monitoring shows error rates returning to normal. Engineering investigating root cause."
mike: Action items: (1) fix concurrency bug in routing kernel (PR ready), (2) add validation to config service to prevent org-global toggles without explicit scope, (3) postmortem and customer RCA.
alice: I'm taking (1) and (2). Will open PRs and link them here.
rachel: Thanks everyone — continuing to monitor. Assigning postmortem owner: rachel. ETA for follow-up update: 17:00 UTC today.
ops-lead: Also add billing reconciliation for customers with higher retry costs. Finance/sales to collaborate.
jen: All clear on smoke tests now. 200 responses for health and generation for test tenants.
carlos: Saving logs and traces to /ops/incidents/1743212345-routing-weight-bug for postmortem.
ops-lead: Closing incident channel once postmortem is published. Great coordination, team. :tada:
